question: In October 2024, who has been appointed as the Secretary of the Ministry of Coal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Dev Dutt**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Vikram Dev Dutt**, a senior bureaucrat from the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), was appointed as the **Secretary of the Ministry of Coal** in **October 2024**. 
• His appointment reflects his extensive experience in various administrative capacities and his ability to manage critical roles in government departments. 
• The **Ministry of Coal** is responsible for overseeing coal production, distribution, and policy formation in India, one of the major sectors contributing to energy and industrial growth. 
• Vikram Dev Dutt has previously held other significant positions, including being associated with the **Ministry of Tourism**, where he contributed to enhancing India's tourism sector. 
• The appointment of a seasoned IAS officer like Vikram Dev Dutt ensures administrative efficiency and robust policy execution in the coal sector. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Ministry of Coal:** 
• The **Ministry of Coal** was established in **1974** to develop and manage India's coal resources. 
• It oversees coal mining operations, formulates policies related to coal production, and ensures its sustainable use. 
• India is the **second-largest coal producer** globally, and coal contributes significantly to the nation's **energy sector**. 
• The ministry also focuses on promoting clean coal technologies and reducing environmental impacts. 
• **Role of the Secretary of Ministry of Coal:** 
• The Secretary of the Ministry of Coal is the administrative head of the ministry and is responsible for implementing government policies efficiently. 
• Key responsibilities include ensuring adequate coal supply to power plants, industries, and other sectors. 
• They also oversee the functioning of public sector undertakings like **Coal India Limited** and its subsidiaries. 
• Promoting sustainable mining practices and exploring renewable energy alternatives also form part of their responsibilities. 
• **Vikram Dev Dutt:** 
• A 1993-batch IAS officer of the **Arunachal Pradesh-Goa-Mizoram-Union Territory (AGMUT) cadre**. 
• He has served in various roles, including as the **Chairman and Managing Director of Air India**, contributing to the aviation sector's growth. 
• Known for his administrative acumen, he has played pivotal roles in policy formulation and project implementation in different ministries. 
• **India's Coal Sector:** 
• Coal contributes to approximately **55% of India's energy needs**, making it a vital resource for industrial and economic growth. 
• Key producers of coal include **Coal India Limited**, which accounts for the majority of India's coal production. 
• India's coal reserves are concentrated in states like **Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and West Bengal**. 
• The government is working towards enhancing coal production and transitioning to **clean energy technologies** to meet future energy demands sustainably. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Coal India Limited:** 
• **Coal India Limited (CIL)** is the world's largest coal producer and a Maharatna company under the Ministry of Coal. 
• CIL operates through its subsidiaries and is responsible for producing and supplying coal to various sectors. 
• It has been instrumental in ensuring India's energy security and driving industrial growth. 
• **Clean Coal Technologies:** 
• To address environmental concerns, India is investing in **clean coal technologies**, such as carbon capture and storage (CCS). 
• Such technologies aim to reduce emissions from coal-based power plants and make coal usage more sustainable. 
• Government initiatives like **National Coal Gasification Mission** are promoting the use of coal gasification for cleaner energy production. </ul
